shots.camText: Opens exactly on Q06's last frame: profile two-shot, her hand on the green pillar · 40 mm · then a gentle pan
shots.note: She takes her hand from the pillar and walks the few stiff steps to the low wall's knee-high end; Oren close beside her.

shots.camText: Medium two-shot, handheld at shoulder height, following her down · 40 mm
shots.note: Her leg wobbles; her hand goes to his shoulder; she lowers herself, jaw clenched, breath held; he is completely still, taking her weight.

shots.camText: Insert: her hand on his shoulder · 65 mm · handheld
shots.note: Her hand stays a beat after she is down; then it lifts away and she turns it palm up, looking at it.

shots.camText: Close-up of Helena seated, at her eye level · 65 mm · handheld
shots.line: HELENA: "That's a hell of an introduction."

lines.text: HELENA: That's a hell of an introduction.

shots.note: From her palm up to him; a small one-sided smile.

shots.camText: Her point of view, low angle up at Oren standing · 32 mm · locked-off
shots.note: Exactly as the first time he said it: the repetition is the joke.

shots.camText: Close-up of Helena seated · 65 mm · handheld
shots.line: HELENA: "I know. I got that one."

lines.text: HELENA: I know. I got that one.

shots.note: A breath-laugh through her nose; then the line.
